test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Science which deals with celestial objects and space.
solution: The correct answer is '**Astronomy**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**Astronomy**'. • It means** 'the scientific study of the sun, moon, stars, etc.' **(नक्षत्रों, सूर्य, ग्रहों तथा चंद्रमा का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन; खगोलविज्ञान, गणित ज्‍योतिष) • *Example: I've always had an interest in **astronomy**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Astronomy.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning** of other words: • **Geography**: the study of the world’s surface, physical qualities, climate, population, products, etc. (भूगोल; विश्‍व भूगोल की सतह, भौतिक लक्षण, मौसम, जनसंख्‍या आदि का अध्‍ययन) • **Astrology**: the study of the positions and movements of the stars and planets and the way that some people believe they affect people and events. (ज्योतिष) • **Geology**: the study of rocks, and of the way they are formed. (चट्टानों और उनके निर्माण-प्रकार का अध्‍ययन; भूविज्ञान) 30:Tac9, The erroneous spelling is '**froun**'.
